name: Café Sabor Grilled Chicken or Carne Asada with Warm Flour Tortillas & Rice
brandOrRestaurant: Café Sabor (Garden City / Bear Lake & Logan, UT)
whyItWorks: Charbroiled carne asada steak or grilled chicken breast wrapped in soft white flour tortillas with white/Spanish rice and fresh avocado slices.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Carne Asada or Chicken Fajitas (eat the meat, flour tortillas, rice, and guacamole/avocado; leave the sautéed bell peppers and onions on the skillet) and ask for no lime squeeze.
watchOuts: CITRUS WARNING: Request no lime wedge squeeze on carne asada or fajitas
